page.title: CI Payroll — Monthly closing
page.subtitle: CNPS 2024 + ITS/DGI engine · Currency: FCFA (XOF) · Configurable workflow (SoD)

close.title: Initiate the closing of a period
close.intro: Closing first moves to "Pending validation". The designated approver of each level (Settings → Workflow) — or, failing that, an administrator or HR manager other than you — must confirm to finalize the period (mandatory separation of duties).
close.subsidiaryHint: Each subsidiary has its own CNPS number → separate closing
close.resultFinalPayslips: including {{count}} final payslip(s) (leavers: prorated pay and final settlement)
close.resultHint: → The expected approver has been notified; follow progress in the history below.
close.pendingWithTeam: Period {{month}} awaiting validation by an administrator or HR manager other than the initiator

livre.title: Digital payroll register
livre.intro: CSV export in CI Labour Inspectorate format — annual summary of all payslips.

history.title: Period history
history.hint: Click a period in validation to view the workflow
history.pendingWithTeam: Awaiting an administrator or HR manager
history.overdue: Deadline passed — the HR team can take over

workflow.title: Validation workflow — {{month}}
workflow.subtitle: Separation of duties (SOX/SoD) · The initiator cannot self-approve
workflow.sodRoleForbidden: Your role does not allow payroll validation (administrator, HR manager or designated approver).
workflow.sodAwaitingDesignated: This level is assigned to {{name}} ({{fn}}): you can act after the {{date}} deadline.
workflow.expectedTeam: Expected approver: an administrator or HR manager other than the initiator
workflow.overdue: Deadline passed — the HR team can take over
workflow.escalatedNotice: Deadline passed or designated approver unavailable: you are acting by escalation (recorded in the audit trail).
workflow.cancelHint: Generated payslips will be deleted and the period will return to preparation (possible as long as no level has approved).
workflow.rejectHint: Generated payslips will be deleted, expense reports and final settlements restored: the period returns to preparation to be recalculated.
workflow.cancelledNotice: Initiation cancelled: the period is back in preparation.
workflow.rejectedNotice: Period sent back to preparation: the initiator has been notified.
workflow.sodInitiator: You initiated this closing — another approver must validate (separation of duties).
workflow.sodAlreadyApproved: You have already approved a level — another approver must take over.
workflow.notesPlaceholder: Checked the totals, consistent with the previous month…
workflow.rejectReasonPlaceholder: E.g.: unexplained variance on CNPS retirement, to be recalculated…

multiSites.title: Multi-subsidiary payroll
multiSites.subtitle: Centralized steering: initiate the month's draft, cascade it to the subsidiaries, track each RAF's submission, then consolidate and close.
multiSites.emptyParents: No multi-subsidiary payroll in progress. Choose a month and click "Initiate draft".
multiSites.circuitHint: Consolidation starts the validation workflow (Settings → Workflow): each level's designated validator approves; the last approval closes the payroll of every subsidiary and publishes the payslips to employees.
multiSites.rejected: Sent back for preparation: "{{reason}}" — each subsidiary must be resubmitted.
multiSites.trackTitle: View the draft's history (who did what, when)
multiSites.notDeclined: Not yet cascaded to subsidiaries. Click "Cascade to subsidiaries".

workflow.rejectHint: The payslips of every subsidiary will be deleted, expense reports and final settlements restored: the payroll goes back to the subsidiaries, and each RAF must resubmit their subsidiary before a new consolidation.
workflow.cancelHint: The payslips of every subsidiary will be deleted and the payroll will go back to the subsidiaries (possible as long as no level has approved).
workflow.rejectedNotice: Payroll sent back for preparation: the initiator and the subsidiaries' RAFs have been notified.
workflow.cancelledNotice: Initiation cancelled: the payroll went back to the subsidiaries.

timeline.heading: Draft history
timeline.empty: No event recorded for this draft.

simulator.title: ITS Simulator — Côte d'Ivoire
simulator.subtitle: CNPS 2024 calculation + ITS scale (2024 reform) · Shares and family-charges tax reduction (RICF) · All amounts in FCFA
simulator.scaleTitle: Monthly ITS scale (Ordinance 2023-719, in force since 01/01/2024)
simulator.scaleNote: Scale applied to 100% of taxable gross: no standard deduction, employee CNPS contributions not deducted. The RICF is then deducted from the gross tax.
simulator.emptyHint:
Fill in the parameters and click Calculate
to get the full CNPS + ITS simulation

detail.intro: Each line is expandable. Click to view the formula, base, rate and legal reference ({{country}}).

comparison.intro: Comparison with previous payslips — detection of unusual variances.
comparison.empty: No history available for this employee

audit.intro: Full history of actions on this payslip (generation, payment, changes).
